identity.note: an epoch is not hashed by the chain, so this projection carries no hash of its own. Its checkable properties are ACROSS captures: every tx_hash here must have a tx_cbor capture, and for a transaction whose block is inside the captured Alonzo window the epoch_no here must equal the epoch_no the block_txs capture reports for the same transaction. The epoch is what selects the cost model a replay is charged under, so taking it from the chain rather than from a constant in the recorder is what stops an era-blind budget comparison from reappearing as a hard-coded number
cross_checks: every tx_hash appears in some tx_cbor_*.fixture.json
for a tx inside the captured window, epoch_no == block_txs_alonzo_window's epoch_no for that tx_hash
